integrity: Self-contained derivation and standalone rational arithmetic checker; numerical finite checks are not an exhaustive lattice proof. Independent external audit has not been performed.
limitations: Planar Euclidean flat tori; squared runner-up geodesic gap; fixed-lattice asymptotics, without uniform degenerating-lattice bounds. The full CDF formula is specific to the sheared-square family. No global full-CDF stochastic ordering is claimed.
title: Exact near-cut-locus gap law on sheared flat tori and a sharp hexagonal intensity bound
